needs.thing: the town's Hist dry and dark, with dead roots round it and its pool cooling, which is also the rootworm's stop
needs.why: Partly met. Seekhat Yol's own Hist (King of the Murkmire's HistTree01, some 23 metres tall at its source scale) stands in the middle of the town with its roots, glands and flowers, its ring of prayer platforms level with its base, and its sap pool at its foot on the south side, out from under the platforms; the root-tender works beside it. Not met yet: its bark is the living tree's (the sick-bark block is owed), and its pool is the stage's living sap, not a cooling one.
needs.fit: The Hist as placed, in the middle of the town, its pool at its south foot.
needs.narrow: Yes: the darkened bark and a cooling pool are the owed sick-bark block; place-people names the root-tender Weeltul.
